parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The MySQL DPI engine version. Valid values: 5.7 and 8.0.

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description: The network type. Only VPC is supported.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance.

- **PREPAY**: subscription
- **POSTPAY**: pay-as-you-go

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

- Year
- Month

For pay-as-you-go instances, the default value is Hour.

parameters.name: PrimaryZone
parameters.description: The primary zone.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the instance resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: SecondaryZone
parameters.description: The secondary zone.

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:

- enterprise: Enterprise Edition.
- standard: Standard Edition.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceRegion
parameters.description: The region in which the source instance resides.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description: The storage type.

parameters.name: TertiaryZone
parameters.description: The zone for Three-zone deployment.

parameters.name: TopologyType
parameters.description:
The topology type. Valid values:

- **3azones**: three-zone deployment.
- **1azone**: single-zone deployment.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. Unit: months or years.

> If Period is set to Year, valid values of this parameter are 1, 2, and 3.
